serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie.face.normal
#bot.Expression.clear
Annalie: Hello there, did you come to look through some clothes?
You: Yeah. 
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: Hi Annalie!
Annalie: It’s nice to see two of my best clients back.
Annalie: That reminds me…
Annalie: My friends set up a new cafe nearby.
Annalie: Place that was there before got wrecked pretty hard and the owners decided to sell the property and move out.
You: Damn, that sucks.
Annalie: For them, yeah, but my friends got a new place pretty cheap.
Bot: Thanks for telling us, Annalie. 
You: Yeah, we will go there for sure, if you are recommending.
Annalie: I’m glad to hear that.
#Annalie.face.shocked
You: How about you go with us?
#Annalie.Eyes.pervy+Annalie.Mouth.smile
Annalie: Huh~ You think you can handle me and {f_botName} at the same time?
You: Don’t phrase it like that…
#Annalie.face.normal
Bot: It could be fun!
Annalie: Sure, why not. I will go, but you are paying.
You: Sure, why not…
Annalie: With that out of the way, let’s look for something for {f_botName}.
